Слова, які з’єднують думки: контраст (al: Words that connect ideas: contrast (although, despite, however), the condition “if not” (unless), “just in case” (in case), purpose (so that) and reason (because, because of). The key question: what comes after the word, a whole clause or a noun.
Контраст у межах речення: although / tho: Contrast within a sentence: although / though / even though + subject + verb
Although it was cold, we went swimming.
Контраст з іменником або -ing: despite /: Contrast with a noun or -ing: despite / in spite of
Despite the rain, the match went on.
Фільм був довгий. Проте ніхто не нудьгув: The film was long. However, nobody got bored.
Ти не покращишся, якщо не будеш тренуват: You won’t improve unless you practise.
Про всяк випадок: in case; мета «щоб»: s: Just in case: in case; purpose “so that”: so that
Візьми парасольку на випадок, якщо піде: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
although / though / even though + підмет: although / though / even though + subject + verb. even though is stronger: “even despite the fact that”. In speech, though can come at the end of a sentence, meaning “however”.
despite / in spite of + іменник, займенн: despite / in spite of + noun, pronoun or -ing. There is no of after despite. Before a whole clause: despite the fact that ...
However починає нове речення, після ньог: However starts a new sentence and is followed by a comma. It can also go inside a sentence between commas.
unless = if ... not. Після unless Presen: unless = if ... not. After unless use the Present Simple, with no not and no will.
in case + Present Simple: робимо щось за: in case + Present Simple: we do something in advance because something else might happen. It is not the same as if.
so that + підмет + can / could / will /: so that + subject + can / could / will / would: purpose, “in order that”.
because + підмет + дієслово; because of: because + subject + verb; because of + noun.
Після despite ніколи не ставимо of. of б: Never put of after despite. of only appears in in spite of.
Після although має бути підмет і дієслов: After although you need a subject and a verb. Before a noun, use despite or in spite of.
unless уже містить «не», тому друге запе: unless already means “if not”, so you don’t need a second negative. And don’t put will after unless.

Для кожного зв’язного слова перевір, що: For each linking word, check what follows it: a whole clause (subject + verb) or a noun / -ing. Table: word, what follows, meaning, example.
Після пропуску іменник (the bad weather): The gap is followed by a noun (the bad weather), so Despite. Although and Even though need a subject with a verb, and However doesn’t join parts of one sentence.
Далі підмет і дієслово (it was), тому al: A subject and a verb follow (it was), so although. despite goes before a noun or -ing.
Після пропуску -ing (feeling), тому in s: The gap is followed by -ing (feeling), so in spite of. although, even though and because need a subject and a verb: although she felt ill.
the storm це іменник, тому because of. b: the storm is a noun, so because of. because goes before a subject and a verb: because it was stormy.
Далі ціле речення (it was raining), тому: A whole clause follows (it was raining), so because. because of, despite and in spite of go before a noun.
Після пропуску підмет і дієслово (he did: The gap is followed by a subject and a verb (he didn’t study), so even though. despite and in spite of need a noun or -ing.
her injury це іменник, тому despite. alt: her injury is a noun, so despite. although would need a verb: although she was injured.
having це -ing, тому Despite. Although і: having is an -ing form, so Despite. Although and Even though need a clause: Although we had a map.
Вираз завжди повний: in spite of. Без of: The phrase is always complete: in spite of. Without of it doesn’t work.
Нове окреме речення після крапки, тому H: A new separate sentence after a full stop, so However with a comma. Although and Despite aren’t used like this at the start with a comma.
Конструкція despite the fact that + рече: The structure is despite the fact that + clause. We don’t say although the fact that.
Далі підмет і дієслово (he lost), тому e: A subject and a verb follow (he lost), so even though. despite, in spite of and because of go before a noun.
the noise це іменник: because of. becaus: the noise is a noun: because of. because + clause: because it was noisy.
Далі речення (it was quite warm), тому t: A clause follows (it was quite warm), so though, which means although. The other options need a noun.
Після despite дієслово з -ing: being. be: After despite the verb takes -ing: being. be or to be are impossible here.
the bad sound це іменник, тому in spite: the bad sound is a noun, so in spite of. although and even though need a subject and a verb.
Причина + речення (she had a cold): beca: Reason + clause (she had a cold): because. because of goes before a noun: because of her cold.
Далі підмет і дієслово (she was angry),: A subject and a verb follow (she was angry), so although. despite is impossible here.
though може стояти в кінці речення у зна: though can come at the end of a sentence, meaning “however”. although, despite and because aren’t used like this at the end.
the pain це іменник: despite. although,: the pain is a noun: despite. although, even though and because need a subject with a verb.
